dedupe_keys.name: etat des stations c velo en temps reel

description: État des stations C.vélo en temps réel is a dataset listed in opendata.clermontmetropole.eu open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CityBike France. Informations sur les services disponibles de chaque station du réseau C.vélo: État de la station, disponibilité des vélos et des emplacements…. Coverage: Clermont Auvergne Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilités - Transports. Its keywords are C.vélo, vélo, vélo libre-service, station, état des stations, disponibilité. The portal shows 82 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-clermontmetropole-eu-portal.
